old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ukyn","title":"Gateway OSCORE ID derivation permits empty and collision-prone truncated identities","description":"P2 security review. PskFederation::derive_context accepts zero-length sender/recipient IDs and does not reject equal IDs. iid_to_sender_id/derive_gateway_ids publicly allow len=0 and arbitrary 1..7 byte prefix truncation; tests even promote 2-byte IDs. Different gateways with the same truncated prefix can therefore receive identical OSCORE identity labels/KIDs, causing context lookup ambiguity and nonce/key identity confusion in a shared-PSK federation. Enforce the federation's unique full 8-byte IID IDs (or maintain a collision-checked allocation registry), reject empty/equal/colliding pairs before Context creation, and add collision/zero-length tests.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:33.845413Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:33.845413Z"}
